Common Mistakes

---------------

\-->



# Common Mistakes



\- Mixing governance with implementation.

\- Creating ambiguous authority.

\- Defining overlapping responsibilities.

\- Ignoring exception handling.

\- Omitting review responsibilities.

\- Contradicting the Constitution.
